overview: A high-configuration QFI infrared microscope for non-contact, wide-field thermography of biased devices and packages. It is best suited to surfaces with calibrated emissivity and optical access; reflective metal regions require careful interpretation or complementary methods.
overviewZh: 高配置 QFI 显微红外系统，用于带电器件和封装的非接触宽场热成像。适合发射率可标定且具备光学通道的表面；高反射金属区域需谨慎解释或结合其他方法。
principle: Infrared optics image the device's thermal radiation onto a detector. Radiance calibration converts the signal into temperature, with corrections for emissivity, reflected background and optical transmission. Semitransparent layers can contribute radiation from multiple depths, so the signal is not automatically the junction temperature.
principleZh: 红外光学系统将器件热辐射成像到探测器，通过辐射标定并校正发射率、背景反射与光路透过率，换算温度。半透明膜层可能使不同深度的辐射叠加，因此测得的辐射温度不能自动等同于结温。
